ledger.contains: Thailand Privilege Card Co. member profile at 30 Sep 2025 (6 image pages, 125 ppi): pp. 1-3 member structure by nationality (146 nationalities, 39,538 members) and package (5 new and 14 discontinued Elite packages, with grand total by package); p. 4 members by package and sex; p. 5 by package and age band; p. 6 by package and occupation, with summary boxes. Taken (all by OCR): number of nationalities; for 123 nationality rows the member total, and for 87 of them the full package split (rows whose cells add up to the printed total in several OCR passes); all package, sex, age and occupation tables with their totals. The source tables have internal inconsistencies (noted on the rows): old-package rows add to 33,902 vs 33,900; Platinum age cells add to 1,035 vs 1,025; Reserve 60+ cell; EFA age cells 1,569 vs 1,549; Others column of small packages repeats the package total. Pass extract-cbi-images-other-2026-10-10 read the nationality x package image (125 ppi) by eye from 3x zoomed crops: package splits added for Japan, USA, British, Australian, Myanmar, Singapore, St Kitts and Nevis, Israeli (rows add up to their totals) and Congolaise (row 136, total 1); Grand Totals added for Australian, Israeli, Switzerland, Danish, Antiguan And Barbudan, Republic of South Africa, Finland, Lietuvos Respublikos (cells do not add up, so splits not recorded). Pass extract-cbi-tha-rest-2026-10-10 re-read every row of the nationality x package table (pp. 1-3) by eye from enlarged crops of the embedded image and compared it with the data: package cells recorded as printed for the 42 rows that had a total only or no entry (rows 7, 8, 9, 15, 18, 19, 20, 21, 23, 26, 28, 32, 36, 38, 39, 40, 44, 46, 47, 49, 51, 52, 54, 57, 58, 60, 61 on p. 1; 62, 67, 73, 77, 80, 85, 91, 92, 93, 94, 103, 104, 106, 112 on p. 2), with each row's notes giving how far its cells are from the printed Grand Total; Grand Totals added for Republic of Turkey (231) and Nepalese (17); 5 cells that earlier passes had missed added to Polish, United Arab Emirates, Lao and Mexicana. All other rows checked against the image and found as stored, apart from the possible corrections listed in to_do. The table prints 137 rows for the 146 nationalities in its header: numbers 53, 59, 117 and 120-125 are absent and 115 is printed twice. The p. 3 grand-total row by package repeats the p. 4 package totals already in the data, except that it leaves Flexible Plus and Flexible Plus Family blank (p. 4: 1 each) and gives Property Co-Project 1 although two rows (Chinese, Switzerland) print 1 each; not added again.
